title: Nifro site entry
description: One curated website that works well as a desktop wallpaper. One YAML file per site in sites/.

name.description: Display name shown in the in-app gallery.

url.description: The URL Nifro loads. Include any query parameters that are part of the recommended setup (kiosk mode, transparent background, etc.).

description.description: One sentence. What the user sees on their desktop.

backend.description: snapshot: the page changes slowly, so Nifro can screenshot it periodically and suspend the web process — power cost near zero. live: the page animates or is meant to be interacted with, so it must keep rendering. Default to snapshot; only use live when animation or interaction is the point.

backendNote.description: Why this backend was chosen, when it is not obvious. Required in spirit for every `live` entry.

reloadInterval.description: Seconds between reloads. For snapshot sites this is also the screenshot cadence. Omit if the page refreshes itself.

css.description: Custom CSS injected into the page. Typically hides nav bars and makes the background transparent.

js.description: Custom JavaScript injected into the page after load.

requiresLogin.description: true if the user must be signed in to the site for it to show anything useful.

screenshot.description: Path or URL of a preview image. Leave unset until an image exists.

source.description: Where this entry came from. Credit the person and link the upstream discussion or issue if you adapted their CSS/JS.

audio.description: The sound setting a site starts with when it is added. Only a starting value: from then on it belongs to the user's copy of the website and is changed from the Sound item in the menu, which this never overrides. Omit for muted, which is what a wallpaper wants unless it is a stream.

featured.description: Ships with the app and is installed on first launch. Keep this list very short: it is what someone sees before they have chosen anything, and every entry is one they have to delete if they do not want it. Among featured entries the file name decides the order, and the first one is the wallpaper that shows.

zoom.description: Fill the wallpaper with one part of the page instead of the whole thing. Given as a place and a magnification rather than a rectangle, so the same entry works on any screen shape: each display works out its own rectangle around that place.

centerX.description: Middle of the region across the page, 0 at the left edge and 1 at the right.

centerY.description: Middle of the region down the page, 0 at the top edge and 1 at the bottom.

scale.description: How many times that part is enlarged to fill the screen.
